issue.title: [ILM] Add searchable snapshot field

labels.name: Team:Kibana Management
labels.description: Dev Tools, Index Management, Upgrade Assistant, ILM, Ingest Node Pipelines, and more t//

repository.name: kibana
repository.description: Your window into all of your data

issue.body:
## Summary Fix https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/83505 Adds functionality for configuring searchable snapshots in the policy UI. ### How to test 1. Start ES with a repo path configured, like: `yarn es snapshot -E path.repo=/tmp/es-snaps` 2. Start Kibana (`yarn start`), go to the "Management" in Kibana and open "Index Lifecycle Policies" 3. Go to create a new policy 4. Enable "Cold phase" and you should see searchable snapshots, but disabled due to license 5. Upload an enterprise license to Elasticsearch and refresh until searchable snapshot is usable in cold (i.e., the toggle appears) 6. Configure searchable snapshot in cold - (optional) you should see a prompt about not having any repositories, follow the instructions to create one use the path you used when you started ES. 7. Give the policy a name and save 8. Open the policy you just created and this time open the advanced settings section in the hot phase and enable searchable snapshots 9. There should be a message about subsequent actions being disabled - this has an effect through the entire form of removing certain fields, like the ability to set searchable snapshot further down in cold (verify this by going to the cold section and seeing that it is now disabled with a callout). 10. Save the policy, re-open it and check that everything was stored correctly. ### Notes * copied functionality from pre-existing "wait for snapshot policy field" ### Screenshots
Hot phase **New collapsed with "advanced settings" section** **Searchable snapshots disabled in advanced settings** **Searchable snapshots enabled in hot phase with no repository created and information callout**
Cold phase **disabled due to license** **enabled in cold**
Gif ![SS-field](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8155004/101505978-32baec80-3975-11eb-8a5c-cc3afabc69db.gif)
## Release note The ILM policy UI now supports configuring searchable snapshot in the cold phase and in the hot phase. ### Checklist Delete any items that are not applicable to this PR. - [ ] Any text added follows [EUI's writing guidelines](https://elastic.github.io/eui/#/guidelines/writing), uses sentence case text and includes [i18n support](https://github.com/elastic/kibana/blob/master/packages/kbn-i18n/README.md) - [x] [Unit or functional tests](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/kibana/master/development-tests.html) were updated or added to match the most common scenarios

issue.title: Fix Inconsistent API Behavior when Cluster never had a Snapshot Repository Configured

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
The behavior of APIs was different depending on whether or not a cluster ever had any
repository configured due to the way we handled the `Custom` `null` values.
Added a default value overload for `#custom` the same way we have it for
custom non-metadata CS values and simplified code accordingly.

Closes #65511
